answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can influence a market, then slash that stake when independently sampled tasks reveal fabricated work. A newcomer can still participate, but cannot cheaply multiply votes or reputation: every identity must lock real value, and a proven fake loses it. Like timber bracing a hollow frame against a gale, the stake makes a swarm costly to build; the attacker pays capital costs up front and forfeits deposits when caught.
